procedure.folds: Six deterministic fits. Each fold holds out exactly one trajectory and fits the same nine MMG hull derivatives to the other five trajectories.
procedure.model_and_optimizer: Reuse the existing KVLCC2-MARIN identification model, input replay, residual normalization, coefficient scaling, bounds, ridge penalty, and 12-iteration bounded regularized Gauss-Newton solver.
procedure.held_out_primary_error: Mean squared normalized trajectory residual through 900 full-scale seconds. Per sample, residual components are wrapped heading error / 5 deg, yaw-rate error / 0.05 deg/s, along-position error / (0.5 Lpp), and cross-position error / (0.5 Lpp). Ridge terms are excluded from held-out error.
procedure.secondary_reporting: Report held-out heading RMSE, yaw-rate RMSE, position RMSE/Lpp, original IMO metrics and tolerances, fitted coefficients, and all coefficients at their optimization bounds.
procedure.bound_hit_rule: A fitted normalized coefficient q is a bound hit when abs(abs(q) - 2) <= 1e-9; bounds are baseline plus/minus 2 * max(abs(baseline), 0.05).

prediction.working_hypothesis: Turning-circle-only coverage under-constrains the fast rudder transient response exercised by zig-zags.
prediction.prospective_prediction: Held-out zig-zag trajectories will have larger primary held-out error than held-out turning-circle trajectories because the two turning circles are relatively redundant while zig-zags exercise distinct transient regimes.
prediction.support_rule: Supported only if every held-out zig-zag primary error is greater than both held-out turning-circle primary errors (min zig-zag error > max turning-circle error).
prediction.contradiction_rule: If the strict separation rule is not met, this leave-one-out result does not support the coverage-gap hypothesis and Task 3 must not proceed on that assumption without review.
prediction.aggregation_guard: All six folds must be reported individually. Group extrema are used only to evaluate the precommitted ordering prediction; no six-case average is a verdict.

immutability: This diagnostic does not alter the original preregistered protocol, original fit, or scoped-negative-result artifact.
